title: Ike Ronson
summary: A Division Agent named in Ubisoft's Broken Dawn overview alongside April Kelleher and Aurelio Diaz, on a search for a new threat to civilization.

claims.text: Ubisoft's Broken Dawn overview identifies Ike Ronson as one of the Division Agents accompanying the novel's investigation.

Ubisoft's Broken Dawn overview names Ike Ronson as a Division Agent joining April Kelleher and Aurelio Diaz, but neither reviewed source mentions a handler called Mantis or an Ann Arbor lead; this archive does not confirm them.
Neither reviewed source describes an ISAC-status countermeasure or a Rogue Agent flag for Ike; the claim remains unconfirmed against the sources on record.

paragraphs.text: Ubisoft's Broken Dawn overview places Ike on the team with April Kelleher and Aurelio Diaz. The reviewed sources do not describe a remote handler or a hidden operation, so that part is not asserted here.
Nothing in the reviewed sources addresses an ISAC-status countermeasure. The question is left open rather than filled in.

verification.notes: Verified against reviewed Broken Dawn sources on 2026-10-12: the publisher catalogue entry is a marketing blurb and names only April Kelleher, Aurelio Diaz and Alex Irvine. Ubisoft's book overview names April Kelleher with Division agents Aurelio Diaz and Ike Ronson. Alani Kelso, the Mantis codename, Ann Arbor, Washington and the intelligence handoff appear in none of them, so those claims are downgraded to unknown and the dependent prose no longer asserts them. Breaking Dawn plot detail needs a readable copy or a detailed chapter summary before it can be restored.
